saturation_diagnostic.saturation_note: T saturates (>0.95) at shared_fraction ≥ 0.0885. Current value 0.0010 is BELOW the saturation point (T=0.0333). Default placeholder 0.15 was past saturation; calibrated 0.001 is well below it.

tau_c.note: tau_c is a per-edge transmissibility threshold (T units). NOT comparable to kappa=0.35 (a density variable).

dimension_note: kappa=0.35 (density threshold) and tau_c (transmissibility threshold) are on orthogonal axes. No numerical comparison is made. kappa=0.35 will be RETIRED, not matched, in the eventual swap.
